newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Pearson buys TML publications stake.
newsitem.headline: Pearson buys TML publications stake.

text.p: International media group Pearson Plc said on Monday it had bought a 50 percent stake in the publisher of South Africa's Business Day and Financial Mail publications for 87.5 million rand ($18.8 million).
Also included in the arrangement is a television production company, African Business Channel (ABC), which currently produces a nightly business news programme on South African national television.
ABC is already a 50/50 partnership between Times Media Ltd, publisher of the newspapers, and FT Television.
Pearson, owner of Britain's Financial Times, said in a published announcement a new company called African Business Media Ltd will be formed to house its various interests.
Pearson said the acquisition would be "earnings enhancing" from the beginning and should be completed around the end of the year.

It said there would be strong liaison between the South African publications and the Financial Times, which would lend its international skills and network to assist the further development of Business Day and Financial Mail.
Business Day has a daily sale of 40,200 and the Financial Mail, a weekly publication, a sale of 31,100.
The deal follows months of speculation that Pearson will take a stake in TML's financial publications. ($1=4.6615 Rand)
